Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing for bed hold for boarding home residents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bed hold for boarding home residents; and addinga new section to chapter 18.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When a boarding home contracts with the department to provideadult residential care services, enhanced adult residential careservices, or assisted living services under chapter 74.39A RCW, theboarding home must hold a medicaid eligible resident's room or unitwhen shortterm care is needed in a nursing home or hospital, theresident is likely to return to the boarding home, and payment is madeunder subsection (2) of this section. (2) The medicaid resident's bed or unit shall be held for a periodof time consistent with the funding that is available to compensate theboarding home for holding the bed or unit. The per day bed or unithold compensation amount shall be seventy percent of the daily ratepaid for the resident who needs shortterm nursing home care orhospitalization. p. 1 SB 5578 (3) If the department is unable to compensate the boarding homeprovider in the amount specified in subsection (2) of this section, orcannot fully cover the number of days needed, the bed or unit holdwill, at that time, become a noncovered medicaid service and theboarding home may seek third party payment. If neither the departmentnor any available third party is able or willing to pay for bed or unithold for shortterm nursing home or hospitalization stay, the medicaidresident may return to the first available and appropriate bed or unit,if the resident continues to meet the admission criteria under thischapter.
